text:
Nora: Heads up, noticed Stripe shows 4 vendor refunds for VEND-209 that we didn't authorize. They came through around 04:15Z.
Kevin: Do we have Stripe ids? any NetSuite records?
Nora: Stripe ids: ref_8Yx..., ref_8Yy..., ref_8Yz..., ref_8Ya... Amounts: $40, $75, $12, $180. NetSuite has matching refund memos but on a different vendor record (VEND-290) for the $180 one.
Priya: That mapping mismatch sounds bad. Were these auto-issued by the price-experiment script?
Kevin: Quick trace: refunds were triggered by our refund-automation service when plan_code didn't match expected billing_key. For the PE rollout we temporarily allowed mapping by product_sku suffix, and the mapper appended "-PE" to billing_key. Webhook handler dedupe uses billing_key+invoice_number; because we changed billing_key for the experiment the dedupe missed and created refunds for the mapped vendor.
Netsuite-admin: NetSuite memos created: RF-240-8Yx, RF-240-8Yy, RF-240-8Yz, and RF-240-8Ya. RF-240-8Ya (USD $180) posted to vendor VEND-290 ledger. I can put posted memo to Pending but to reverse >$100 need finance sign-off.
billing-bot: webhook-processor replay job 9954 triggered refunds for job refund-automation at 2401234633 :warning:
Nora: Impact: total refunds ~$307, one posted $180. Affected customers: 3 external customers (they will see refunds).
Priya: Approve reversing the posted $180 if it's incorrect. I need a short remediation plan before sign-off.
Kevin: Short-term fix: rollback product_sku-suffix mapping (5m) and normalize billing_key generation to strip experiment suffix before dedupe (hotfix ~10m).
Kevin: Remediation steps:
1) Pause refund-automation queue (done).
2) Hotfix mapper: strip / ignore -PE suffix for dedupe and external_id generation. Deploy quick.
3) Create a script to identify refunds with billing_key containing "-PE" and mark candidates for void or reversal.
4) For the posted $180, netsuite-admin to set to Pending and we'll post a reversing journal once finance approves.
Netsuite-admin: Set RF-240-8Ya to Pending at 2401234640, auto-post disabled. I'll prepare reversal entry and link to FIN-3723.
Priya: Approved reversal for $180 (VEND-290). Proceed with journal once you attach FIN-3723 reference. For remaining <$100 refunds proceed to void automatically after we run the script.
Kevin: Hotfix PR opened: fix/strip-pe-billingkey (https://git.example.com/r/redwood/refund/pulls/441). Running CI.
Nora: Can you also list Stripe refs so ops can notify customers and block any further automated refunds?
Kevin: Stripe refs pushed to FIN-3723 (list attached). I'll also add a temporary rule to block refunds where billing_key contains "-PE".
billing-bot: deploy:rollback/refund-mapper triggered by kevin at 2401234680, CI green :rocket:
Kevin: Deployed normalization at 2401234685. Running scan script now to find -PE refunds.
Kevin: Scan results: 6 records with billing_key including "-PE". Four already voided, two (including the $180) require manual reversal. Script output saved to FIN-3723.
Nora: I'll send customer comms for the 3 visible refunds and offer to re-bill if needed after fix.
Netsuite-admin: Prepared reversal journal for RF-240-8Ya and attached FIN-3723. Ready to post on Priya sign.
Priya: Posting reversal approved. Please include memo "Auto-refund remap mistake - FIN-3723" and tag for audit.
Netsuite-admin: Posted reversal at 2401234698 and updated FIN-3723. Ledger reconciled.
Kevin: Longer term: add canonical billing_key = stripe_product_id + customer_id, never include experiment suffix; add unit tests and a canary for refund-automation.
Priya: Good. Owners: Kevin (code + normalization), Netsuite-admin (journals + saved search), Nora (customer comms + FIN ticket). Target: normalization deployed and posted reversal within 1hr, customer comms sent within 4h.
Netsuite-admin: Adding saved search: vendor refunds created by automation with billing_key like "%-PE%" and email finance at 2401234699.
Nora: Thanks team. Closing once comms sent and FIN-3723 updated.
